confidence.notes: Verified on hardware (firmware 3133, part 006-B4062-00): the map renders, mixed-case Swiss labels are correct, and DEM shaded relief DOES render -- though it is too dark/contrasty at 1 arc-second in alpine terrain. GarminDevice.xml advertises Garmin/CustomMaps and Garmin/BirdsEye directories, which contradicts the common claim that Edge devices cannot take raster maps; unproven, but worth investigating for raster fidelity. NOT measured: maxImgBytes, maxTilesPerMapset. See docs/device-verification.md B. Custom Map raster limits are community figures, NOT measured here and NOT published by Garmin (whose own documentation was unreachable): 100 tiles across all KMZ files on the device and 1 megapixel per tile. The 500-tile allowance is reported only for Montana, Oregon 6x0 and GPSMAP 64, which this is not, so 100 is the safe figure. Unverified on hardware -- see docs/device-verification.md I. USB mode: the Edge 840 offers NO setting to present itself as a USB drive -- MTP is its only mode, per Garmin's own Edge 840 forum, so the app must not suggest changing one. Community-sourced, not vendor-documented. Files reach it through MTP: File Explorer on Windows, which speaks MTP natively, or a tool such as OpenMTP on macOS, which has no MTP support of its own.
